scope: Benchmark-authored second condition for every accepted Temporal extension family included in the temporal and both case packs. This artifact does not modify a source ScienceCard, registry, or prior artifact.

inputs.science_card_resolution: For every family, read science_card.batch and resolve science_card.json_pointer from the release manifest.

authoring_contract.selection_basis: Parameter semantics and predeclared numerical/domain robustness only; no tested-LLM behavior or benchmark score was inspected or used.
authoring_contract.intervention_rule: Change exactly one source-model parameter to one finite target having the exact same unit. Keep controls, readouts, control domain, formula tree, all other parameters, and fixed experimental design unchanged.
authoring_contract.preferred_target_rule: Prefer a same-sign 25-50 percent change in a nonzero scale or coefficient. Depart from that range only when a discrete parameter requires integer values in both the full-target and midpoint variants.

constructor_semantics.easy: Full preregistered target (fraction 1.0); selected here as the one benchmark-authored second condition for the four-case source/counterfactual by Identification/Discovery design.
constructor_semantics.hard: Source-to-target midpoint (fraction 0.5); retained as a deterministic construction and ordering canary, not selected here as an additional temporal-pack condition.

authoring_contract.separation_metric: RMS symmetric tolerance-scaled source-versus-counterfactual separation over the fixed diagnostic design.
acceptance_checks: The request unit exactly matches the compiled source parameter unit.
The target differs from the source value and the expression remains total over the entire declared control domain.
The existing constructor returns ordered easy and hard variants.
MatchedFamilySpec validation succeeds for each returned variant.
Known-truth submissions for source and counterfactual both pass Identification and Discovery held-out evaluation.

families.rationale: The positive fitted zero-temperature critical-field intercept is a multiplicative scale. Increasing it by 25 percent preserves tesla units, sign, the transition-temperature parameter, the linear temperature dependence, and the zero crossing at the source-supported Tc.
families.total_domain_check: For temperature t in [0.25, 1.4] K, bc_perp_0*(1-t/tc) is finite and nonnegative for source, midpoint, and target bc_perp_0 values; all three retain the same zero at tc=1.4 K.
